scope: Repository, Supabase migrations and live read-only Supabase bucket/metadata checks, ingestion/parser/chunking, provenance, graph retrieval/evidence and tests.

verification_limitations: Only five of 32 referenced object paths were checked with HEAD; object bytes were not downloaded.
Image/chunk matching was checked by latest ingestion run, source page, and block ID using existing source metadata.

capabilities.name: Image extraction from source documents
capabilities.finding: Docling identifies IMAGE blocks; blank-text blocks are rendered from their PDF page coordinates as PNG crops. This does not extract every embedded image object or crop nonblank IMAGE blocks.

capabilities.name: Image persistence in Supabase
capabilities.finding: Verified PNG crops are stored in the existing private bucket before screening metadata is written. Live project contains 32 image metadata rows with complete storage references; five sampled paths returned HTTP 200.

capabilities.name: Asset metadata and storage references
capabilities.finding: Metadata stores image SHA-256, private bucket/path, byte size, run/page/block, reading order, coordinates, OCR status/hash/length, screening decision and flags. There is no separate asset_id; image_sha256 is the content identity.

capabilities.name: Provenance links to document hash, run, physical page, source block, and asset ID
capabilities.finding: Run ID, page, block and image digest are explicit. Document SHA is derivable through the run FK. No standalone asset ID or direct source SHA column is stored on image_screening_results.

capabilities.name: OCR/text extraction from images
capabilities.finding: Local page OCR can emit canonical TEXT blocks and blank IMAGE crops have a dedicated Tesseract OCR screening path. Crop OCR text is transient; only its hash and length are persisted and it does not enter chunks/retrieval text.

capabilities.name: Image captions, descriptions, and visual summaries
capabilities.finding: No generated visual descriptions, captioning service, persisted descriptive field, or caption-to-image relation was found.

capabilities.name: Image, table, and figure references in canonical documents
capabilities.finding: CanonicalBlock supports IMAGE and TABLE types with page-scoped block IDs, text and coordinates. There is no canonical storage reference, asset ID, figure number, or explicit caption relationship; the full canonical document is represented durably by a digest rather than a canonical table row.

capabilities.name: Relationships between visual assets and document chunks
capabilities.finding: No persistent asset-to-chunk FK, relationship record, CPCR mapping, or graph edge exists. Live comparison found 0 of 32 current image page/block pairs in chunk source metadata.

capabilities.name: Visual content availability to retrieval and evidence assembly
capabilities.finding: Text emitted by OCR/page parsing can enter ordinary text chunks. Crop OCR is not canonicalized or chunked; EvidenceBundle and Neo4j graph contain text and source coordinates but no visual asset reference or bytes.

capabilities.name: Failure handling, idempotency, and asset versioning
capabilities.finding: Upload retry, digest/path determinism, exact-replay upsert, immutable metadata keys and safe orphan reconciliation exist. Each run gets a separate hashed prefix; there is no independent asset version registry or stable asset ID.

recommended_remaining_tasks: Use the existing ingestion-run/page/block key and image digest/path to resolve image assets; do not mint a second asset ID.
Preserve admitted crop OCR as source-backed canonical text with offsets and provenance, then include it in existing chunk/retrieval processing.
Link chunks/evidence to existing image metadata by the stable run/page/block key and test identity/provenance checks.
Add captions or visual descriptions only for cases OCR cannot represent, with a documented retention and screening contract.
Add lifecycle tests for replay, same-key content conflict, new-run versioning, reconciliation failures, and asset-backed evidence.
